_comment: Transcribed verbatim from docs/skeleton.md (SKELETON_MAP), Mixamo Xbot, T-pose rest.
All rotations are OFFSETS from the T-pose rest pose, in degrees. 0 on every axis = rest.
'range' is the usable envelope per axis; outside it the mesh visibly deforms.
Bone names here are the logical names; the GLB uses a 'mixamorig:' prefix which the

Hips.note: Root pelvis. x: tilt fwd(+)/back(-). y: rotate whole body left(+)/right(-). z: tilt sideways.

Spine.note: Lower torso. x: bend fwd(+)/back(-). y: twist torso. z: side bend (+ leans to the fighter's right).

Spine1.note: Mid torso. Same as Spine but smaller range.

Spine2.note: Upper chest. Small corrections. Arms attach here.

Neck.note: x: look down(+)/up(-). y: turn head left(+)/right(-). z: tilt head sideways.

Head.note: Same axes as Neck. Combine Neck + Head for full head range.

LeftArm.note: Upper arm. T-pose=0. z: raise overhead(+)/lower to side(-); -90z = arm at side. y: swing forward(-)/back(+). x: twist along the bone. See SPEC_NOTES.md #1.

LeftForeArm.note: Elbow. y(-): bend elbow (curl toward bicep). x: minor pronation.

LeftHand.note: Wrist. x: flex down(+)/extend up(-). z: side bend.

RightArm.note: Upper arm (mirror). z: raise overhead(-)/lower to side(+); +90z = arm at side. y: swing forward(+)/back(-). x: twist. See SPEC_NOTES.md #1.

LeftUpLeg.note: Thigh. x: kick forward(-)/extend back(+). y: twist. z: spread outward(+)/inward(-).

LeftLeg.note: Knee. x(+): bend knee. Cannot hyperextend.

LeftFoot.note: Ankle. x: point toes down(-)/flex up(+). z: ankle roll.

LeftToeBase.note: Toe pivot. x(+): curl toes up.

RightUpLeg.note: Thigh (mirror). x: kick forward(-)/back(+). z: spread outward(-)/inward(+).

mirror._comment: skeleton.md: a left-side pose mirrors to the right by negating y and z and leaving x alone, with Left*/Right* joints swapped. agent_b is agent_a mirrored across X.
